/*AdmScrenTranBasDAO.listAdmScrenTranBas 어드민화면거래기본 목록 조회 */ SELECT SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD /* 화면거래구분코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */ , UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 상위화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_NM /* 화면거래명 */ , URL_ADDR /* URL주소 */ , SCREN_TRAN_LVEL /* 화면거래레벨 */ , MENU_REPST_YN /* 메뉴표시여부 */ , WHOL_ALLOW_YN /* 전체허용여부 */ , SSTV_INFO_YN /* 민감정보여부 */ , REPST_ORDR /* 표시순서 */ , DESC_CTNT /* 설명내용 */ , USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , FRST_REGI_USER_ID /* 최초등록사용자아이디 */ , FRST_REGI_TMSP /* 최초등록타임스탬프 */ , LAST_CHNG_USER_ID /* 최종변경사용자아이디 */ , LAST_CHNG_TMSP /* 최종변경타임스탬프 */ FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE CTR AS ( SELECT A.*, CONVERT( LPAD(CONVERT(A.REPST_ORDR,CHAR(10)), 10, '0'), CHAR(100)) AS HIERARCHY, 1 AS LEVEL FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL = 0 UNION ALL SELECT B.*, CONVERT( CONCAT(C.HIERARCHY, '.', LPAD(CONVERT(B.REPST_ORDR,CHAR(10)), 10, '0')), CHAR(100)) AS HIERARCHY, C.LEVEL + 1 AS LEVEL FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B INNER JOIN CTR C ON B.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID = C.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT * FROM CTR ) T WHERE 1=1
AND ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{admBzwkLclsCd},'%')
AND ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{admBzwkMclsCd},'%')
AND SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{screnTranDvCd},'%')
AND SCREN_TRAN_LVEL >= #{screnTranLvel}
AND MENU_REPST_YN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{menuRepstYn},'%')
AND USE_YN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{useYn},'%')
ORDER BY HIERARCHY ASC

/*AdmScrenTranBasDAO.listAdmScrenTranBasByHierarchy 어드민화면거래기본 계층별 목록조회 */ SELECT SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD /* 화면거래구분코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */ , UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 상위화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_NM /* 화면거래명 */ , URL_ADDR /* URL주소 */ , SCREN_TRAN_LVEL /* 화면거래레벨 */ , MENU_REPST_YN /* 메뉴표시여부 */ , WHOL_ALLOW_YN /* 전체허용여부 */ , SSTV_INFO_YN /* 민감정보여부 */ , REPST_ORDR /* 표시순서 */ , DESC_CTNT /* 설명내용 */ , USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE CTR AS ( SELECT A.*, CONVERT( LPAD(CONVERT(A.REPST_ORDR,CHAR(10)), 10, '0'), CHAR(100)) AS HIERARCHY, 1 AS LEVEL FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.SCREN_TRAN_LVEL = 0 AND A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD IN ('00','10') /* 화면거래구분코드(00=메뉴그룹, 10=화면일반) */ UNION ALL SELECT B.*, CONVERT( CONCAT(C.HIERARCHY, '.', LPAD(CONVERT(B.REPST_ORDR,CHAR(10)), 10, '0')), CHAR(100)) AS HIERARCHY, C.LEVEL + 1 AS LEVEL FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS B INNER JOIN CTR C ON B.UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID = C.SCREN_TRAN_ID WHERE B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD IN ('00','10') /* 화면거래구분코드(00=메뉴그룹, 10=화면일반) */ ) SELECT * FROM CTR ) T WHERE 1=1 AND SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD IN ('00','10') /* 화면거래구분코드(00=메뉴그룹, 10=화면일반) */ ORDER BY HIERARCHY ASC

/*AdmScrenTranBasDAO.selectAdmScrenTranBas 어드민화면거래기본 정보 조회 */ SELECT SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD /* 화면거래구분코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */ , ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */ , UP_SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 상위화면거래아이디 */ , SCREN_TRAN_NM /* 화면거래명 */ , URL_ADDR /* URL주소 */ , SCREN_TRAN_LVEL /* 화면거래레벨 */ , MENU_REPST_YN /* 메뉴표시여부 */ , WHOL_ALLOW_YN /* 전체허용여부 */ , SSTV_INFO_YN /* 민감정보여부 */ , REPST_ORDR /* 표시순서 */ , DESC_CTNT /* 설명내용 */ , USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , FRST_REGI_USER_ID /* 최초등록사용자아이디 */ , FRST_REGI_TMSP /* 최초등록타임스탬프 */ , LAST_CHNG_USER_ID /* 최종변경사용자아이디 */ , LAST_CHNG_TMSP /* 최종변경타임스탬프 */ FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS WHERE 1=1 AND SCREN_TRAN_ID = #{screnTranId} /* 화면거래아이디 */

/*AdmScrenTranBasDAO.listAdmScrenGroup 어드민화면그룹 목록조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.REPST_ORDR, A.GROUP_ID, A.SCREN_TRAN_ID) AS num , A.GROUP_ID /* 그룹아이디 */ , A.GROUP_NM /* 그룹명 */ , A.GROUP_DV_CD /* 그룹구분코드 */ , A.USE_YN /* 사용여부 */ , A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */ , A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */ , A.SCREN_TRAN_ID /* 화면거래아이디 */ , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM /* 화면거래명 */ , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD /*화면거래구분코드*/ , A.SSTV_INFO_YN /*민감정보여부*/ FROM ( SELECT A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD , A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD , A.SSTV_INFO_YN , A.SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , B.GROUP_ID , B.GROUP_NM , B.GROUP_DV_CD , B.USE_YN , B.REPST_ORDR , B.FRST_REGI_TMSP FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_BAS B ON 1=1 WHERE A.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD , A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD , A.SSTV_INFO_YN , A.SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , C.GROUP_ID , C.GROUP_NM , C.GROUP_DV_CD , C.USE_YN , C.REPST_ORDR , C.FRST_REGI_TMSP FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH B ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = B.SCREN_TRAN_ID INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_BAS C ON C.GROUP_ID = B.GROUP_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.GROUP_DV_CD = #{groupDvCd} /* 그룹구분코드 */
AND A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD = #{admBzwkLclsCd} /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */
AND A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD = #{admBzwkMclsCd} /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */
AND UPPER(A.GROUP_ID), UPPER(A.GROUP_NM) LIKE '%', UPPER(#{groupIdOrNm}), '%'
AND (UPPER(A.SCREN_TRAN_ID) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{screnIdOrNm}), '%') OR UPPER(A.SCREN_TRAN_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{screnIdOrNm}), '%'))
ORDER BY A.REPST_ORDR, A.GROUP_ID, A.SCREN_TRAN_ID

/*AdmScrenTranBasDAO.selectCountAdmScrenGroup 어드민화면그룹 목록 건수 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM ( SELECT A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD , A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD , A.SSTV_INFO_YN , A.SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , B.GROUP_ID , B.GROUP_NM , B.GROUP_DV_CD , B.USE_YN , B.REPST_ORDR , B.FRST_REGI_TMSP FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_BAS B ON 1=1 WHERE A.WHOL_ALLOW_YN = 'Y' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD , A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD , A.SSTV_INFO_YN , A.SCREN_TRAN_ID , A.SCREN_TRAN_NM , A.SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD , C.GROUP_ID , C.GROUP_NM , C.GROUP_DV_CD , C.USE_YN , C.REPST_ORDR , C.FRST_REGI_TMSP FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS A INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_ATH B ON A.SCREN_TRAN_ID = B.SCREN_TRAN_ID INNER JOIN ADM_GROUP_BAS C ON C.GROUP_ID = B.GROUP_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.GROUP_DV_CD = #{groupDvCd} /* 그룹구분코드 */
AND A.ADM_BZWK_LCLS_CD = #{admBzwkLclsCd} /* 어드민업무대분류코드 */
AND A.ADM_BZWK_MCLS_CD = #{admBzwkMclsCd} /* 어드민업무중분류코드 */
AND (UPPER(A.GROUP_ID) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{groupIdOrNm}),'%') OR UPPER(A.GROUP_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{groupIdOrNm}),'%'))
AND (UPPER(A.SCREN_TRAN_ID) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{screnIdOrNm}),'%') OR UPPER(A.SCREN_TRAN_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{screnIdOrNm}),'%'))
SELECT SCREN_TRAN_ID , SCREN_TRAN_NM , URL_ADDR AS URL_PATTERN , USE_YN FROM ADM_SCREN_TRAN_BAS WHERE SCREN_TRAN_DV_CD != '00' ORDER BY SCREN_TRAN_ID
